{{Quote|This is the Galactic Alliance battle cruiser ''Starrunner''! We are under heavy attack by new fighters! They are penetrating our shields|Unidentified ''Starrunner'' officer|<ref name="Legacy—War 4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''''Starrunner''''' was an [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|MC140 ''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]] in service to the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|Galactic Alliance]] [[Core Fleet]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[138 ABY]] it participated during the space battle above [[Taivas]] when the forces of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attacked]] the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Temple]]. The ''Starrunner'' was destroyed by a group of [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighters]].
